sources.title: OpenMed — local-first clinical AI
sources.snippet: OpenMed 2.2.0 · on-device clinical AI Your data. Your model. Your iPhone. OpenMed reads clinical text and removes 55+ PHI types on the hardware you control, so patient data never leaves the device. 2,000+ Apache-2.0 models, 33 model-backed PII languages, state of the art on 10 of 12 biomedical NER benchmarks — and a new release most weeks.

sources.title: OpenMed - Local-first Healthcare AI that Never Leaves the Device
sources.snippet: Local-first Healthcare AI That never leaves the device Turn clinical text into structured insight with one line of code. Entity extraction, PII de-identification, and 1,000+ specialized medical models that run entirely on your own hardware — from a one-liner in Python to a native Swift app on iPhone, powered by Apple MLX. No cloud. No vendor lock-in. No patient data leaving your network.
